task.title: Adding additional Certificate Authorities to the Red Hat Quay container
task.shortdesc: To add Certificate Authorities to a standalone Red Hat Quay container, you can copy CA files into the extra_ca_certs directory in your configuration folder and restart the registry container. Red Hat Quay uses these certificates to verify TLS connections to external services.

ul.li: You have a CA for the desired service.
